game_profile.perspective: 固定平视界面，左侧情景插画、右侧棋盘面板
game_profile.core_gameplay: Original generated unique Sudoku; four difficulties, original correct-entry streak and timed completion bonus.
game_profile.core_experience: 英伦棚屋氛围的休闲数独：角色Knott陪伴吐槽，配SHED FM电子乐与随机器情景小事件
game_profile.controls: Click cells or number pad,1–9/arrows/Backspace; new puzzle/difficulty/mute.
game_profile.game_loop: 开始：自动生成当前难度题目；操作：选格填数，对错即时反馈；结果：正确填入加分并更新最高分，错误标红可改；继续：继续填同一题，刷新后分数与最高分恢复、题目重新生成
game_profile.content: 固定数量：4档难度（EASY/MEDIUM/HARD/EXPERT）；程序生成：棋盘题目由生成器实时产出，Easy界面标注36个空格；无固定关卡表
game_profile.progression: 题号随已完成数递增，默认难度随完成数提升；累计分数、最高分与最佳时间跨局保留（最佳时间记录未实机验证）
game_profile.save: Original shedoku localStorage records; score/highscore/solved/PB/difficulty, original fresh puzzle after reload.
game_profile.rules: 目标：填满全部空格且每行每列每宫1–9不重复；成功：完成整盘（未实机完成）；失败：无硬失败，错误填入标红且可修改；计分：正确填入加分（实证单题内10→22），具体公式与连击阈值未确认
game_profile.systems: 题目生成与唯一解校验系统；格子选中与行列宫/同数高亮；正误判定与红绿反馈；计分与连击；计时；本地存档；Knott情景事件系统（干扰弹窗、茶杯、烟灰缸互动）；SHED FM音乐轮换与音量/静音控制
game_profile.ui_flow: 主界面：左栏标题、PB、收音机与角色，右栏难度、计时/分数/最高分/已解、棋盘、数字键盘与状态行；干扰事件以弹窗覆盖，点Back to Sudoku返回棋盘
game_profile.level_design: 无手工关卡，程序生成；难度通过空格数量区分，Easy为36空（界面实证），其余档位具体空格数未确认
game_profile.verification: Desktop1280x720 actual UI. Visible givens independently solved outside page; ordinary cell clicks/number keys only, no hidden solution or state manipulation. Original Easy36 blanks solved in1:15 score1438 bonus748. Wrong number red feedback and clear, new Medium42-blank puzzle, reload actual score/highscore1438 solved1 PB1:15 and Medium restored. Original design regenerates board on reload, does not save mid-puzzle. Medium/Hard/Expert full wins, mobile/touch and audio hearing not exhausted. Complete network window reload/full Easy win/new/reload with no truncation, external request, missing asset or console error.
game_profile.evidence: main.js（题目生成、存档读写、渲染与反馈逻辑）；index.html（界面结构）；runtime运行报告steps与screenshots/startup.png、step-0至step-8；localStorage键shedoku内容哈希随计分更新且刷新后保留
